prompt:
A 2D platformer TILESET sheet: a clean grid of SQUARE tiles, evenly spaced, each tile in its own cell with black space between cells. All tiles the same size.

THEME: a rain-slick cyberpunk Japanese rooftop and service-deck. These are the surfaces the player stands on, so they must read CLEARLY and be brighter and higher-contrast than the background city.

TILES, one per cell:
1. Ground TOP tile: dark concrete body with a bright cyan #35C6F4 glowing strip along the upper surface, and a hint of wet reflection under the strip.
2. Ground INTERIOR tile: darker concrete with subtle panel seams and rivets.
3. Ground LEFT edge and 4. Ground RIGHT edge: the same, with the lit strip wrapping down the corresponding side.
5. Metal grating tile with visible slats and a faint cyan underglow.
6. Circuit-etched wall panel with glowing acid-green #C6F02A traces.
7. Thin ONE-WAY platform: a narrow deck with a bright cyan lit top surface and an open underside showing support struts.
8. Hazard tile: dark angular spikes with hot red #E01F26 glowing tips.
9. Horizontal pipe run and 10. Vertical pipe run, industrial, with valve collars.
11. A vent tile with louvres and faint warm light behind them.
12. A rusted steel plate with weld seams and orange #FF6B1A corrosion streaks.

Tiles must line up so adjacent tiles connect seamlessly, and must read as ONE consistent set.

ART DIRECTION: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners aesthetic — hyper-saturated neon against deep shadow, bold flat anime colour blocking, grimy lived-in megacity surfaces.

PIXEL ART: chunky visible square pixels on a strict grid, hard aliased edges, a 1-pixel dark outline, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur.

BACKGROUND: PURE BLACK #000000 everywhere around and between the tiles. NO grid lines drawn over the art, NO borders, NO labels, NO text, NO watermark.

PALETTE: #000000 #0A0E1F #14103A #241A5C #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #00E5FF #8FE8FF #B026FF #FF2D95 #FF6B1A #FFD400 #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568.

A row of separate FOREGROUND PROP sprites for a 2D cyberpunk game, evenly spaced with wide black gaps between them, each complete and uncropped, all standing on a shared invisible ground line.

These sit in the PLAYABLE layer close to the camera, so they are brighter, sharper and more saturated than distant background buildings.

PROPS:
1. A neon vending machine, glowing cyan and magenta, with a lit product window.
2. A stack of three shipping crates with acid-green stencil marks.
3. A tall street sign post carrying several small glowing signboards.
4. An air-conditioning condenser unit with a slow fan and warning stripes.
5. A cluster of pipes and valves rising from the deck, venting faint steam.
6. A hanging paper lantern on a bracket, glowing warm amber.
7. A small stone fox-spirit statue on a plinth, weathered, with glowing cyan eyes.
8. A broken holographic advertising panel, cracked, flickering magenta.
9. A coil of heavy cable and a junction box with a blinking red light.
10. A rooftop water tank on short steel legs.
